messages:
rachel: opened a tiny PR to fix /stream docs  examples showed chunked JSON-lines but runtime emits SSE (event: message, data: JSON). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
mohit: saw it. also found the JS snippet used `Authorization: $REDWOOD_KEY` missing the `Bearer ` prefix which trips many browser examples. will standardize to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY`.
felix: the OpenAPI example shows response `message: string` but server returns `events: [{type: 'message', data: {...}}]`. we should update the response schema and add a migration note mapping old `message` -> `events[0].data.text`.
rachel: updated examples to show SSE shape and added an explicit curl SSE example:
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=gpt-4&input=hello"
```
mohit: added an EventSource JS snippet and a small note about `event.data` being JSON-encoded. standardized fence languages to `bash`, `javascript`, `python`. also normalized model ids to canonical `gpt-4` across all snippets.
docs-bot: PR opened by rachel (docs) - "stream: SSE examples, auth header fix, response schema update" - CI: running
tara: quick runtime check: SSE events include `type: output` and `data: {text: ..., tokens: [...]}`. I added that structure to the response table and a tiny migration snippet for older clients that previously parsed a raw `message` string.
felix: nit: add a one-line troubleshooting note: if your client sees `event: retry` it's a server hint and should not be treated as model output. also mention SSE reconnection/backoff.
rachel: added troubleshooting and a changelog entry: "/stream: switch to SSE canonical event format; clients should parse event.data as JSON. Auth header must be 'Bearer <token>'. Old message-shaped responses accepted for 21 days."
mohit: CI green. all good from docs side. merging after squash. :shipit:
